brands.name: Kona Surf Co
brands.short_description: Wildwood, New Jersey surfboards by Mike Sciarra — performance shortboards, fishes, and mid-lengths.

models.name: Zen XL
models.description: The Zen XL is an elevated version of the popular Zen, designed specifically for larger surfers seeking high performance and fun in the water. Over 6 feet in length with ample volume, it offers improved paddling, glide, and wave catching ability, especially on smaller days. Its classic fish outline features a rounded nose, a forward wide point, and extra length that enhances paddling and stability. Single to double concave with channels, swallow tail with double wings, and tucked-in rails. Outline: performance midlength with wide point center. Tail: swallow with slight wing.

models.name: ZoSO
models.description: The ZoSO is a versatile board that combines classic egg-inspired design with modern performance features. Streamlined low-entry rocker and well-distributed foam for paddling and speed on smaller days; double-barrel concave and tail channels for controlled turns from shoulder-high to overhead. Chined rails in the midsection transitioning to sharper rails forward. Ride as a twin for a loose feel or with a small stabilizer for more drive. Outline: hybrid egg with wide point forward. Tail: double rounded with slight wing.
